wsjHeadlines.title: Stock Market Today: Tech Stocks Set to Rise After Nvidia Earnings Soothe AI Jitters
wsjHeadlines.description: Chip maker sought to reassure on its prospects without Jensen Huang

wsjHeadlines.title: Walmart’s Winning Combo: Thrifty Shoppers and Wary AI Investors
wsjHeadlines.description: Plus, Nvidia’s earnings tailwind, and Anthropic’s multibillionaires.

wsjHeadlines.title: Nvidia’s Strong Fundamentals Give New CEO a Much-Needed Tailwind
wsjHeadlines.description: The company inherits problems from Jensen Huang, and advantages.

wsjHeadlines.title: How Everyday Investors Are Playing the Nvidia Drama
wsjHeadlines.description: Millions of people have a financial stake in the company, so we asked three of them to play stock analyst and share their thoughts.

wsjHeadlines.title: Slower Retail Sales Drag on Market
wsjHeadlines.description: Plus, the SEC probes Nvidia and Disney is cutting costs

wsjHeadlines.title: Corporate-Card Startup Ramp Raising Funds at $70 Billion Valuation
wsjHeadlines.description: The financing round is the fast-growing company’s third fundraise in a year.

wsjHeadlines.title: Anthropic Plans to Raise IPO Price After Strong Demand
wsjHeadlines.description: The company has pitched investors through market tumult and the shock resignation of Nvidia’s Jensen Huang.

wsjHeadlines.title: Why Big Investors Are Burning Lenders on Apartment Loans
wsjHeadlines.description: Deep-pocketed landlords like Brookfield may be the most willing to cut their losses on troubled properties.

wsjHeadlines.title: Big Tech Needs to Spread Its Bets on Data Centers
wsjHeadlines.description: Artificial-intelligence players that bet too much on a handful of mega projects look vulnerable after the midterm elections.

wsjHeadlines.title: Gucci Is Cutting Prices. Louis Vuitton Is Reluctant to Follow the Trend.
wsjHeadlines.description: With luxury demand weak, executives are debating one of the sector’s big taboos.

wsjHeadlines.title: CVS Breakup Won’t Satisfy Washington. It Could Still Work for Wall Street.
wsjHeadlines.description: Spinning off its drugstores won’t quiet CVS’s critics, but it could leave shareholders with a more valuable company.

wsjHeadlines.title: Nvidia Shareholders Won’t Miss Jensen Huang for Long
wsjHeadlines.description: Steadier hands could be better suited to enriching shareholders as the AI chip company enters a new phase.

wsjHeadlines.title: JPMorgan Chase Names Bregje de Best to Succeed Jeremy Barnum as CFO
wsjHeadlines.description: De Best joined JPMorgan in 2006 and has been finance chief of its commercial and investment bank since June 2025.

wsjHeadlines.title: Deutsche Bank Shares Drop After Leaks Put Spotlight on Troubled Past
wsjHeadlines.description: A media consortium reported on failings in the bank’s handling of high-risk customers, including Russian oligarchs and Jeffrey Epstein.

wsjHeadlines.title: Anthropic Chief Tells Jamie Dimon He Hopes IPO Will ‘Underpromise and Overdeliver’
wsjHeadlines.description: The artificial-intelligence giant, which is expected to begin trading Thursday, is targeting a valuation of roughly $1.33 trillion or more.

wsjHeadlines.title: AI Bots Are Using Credit Cards. Banks Are Racing to Keep Up.
wsjHeadlines.description: Stripe is positioning itself as a key cog for agentic commerce, while JPMorgan Chase is a skeptic.

wsjHeadlines.title: Metro Bank Hangs Up ‘For Sale’ Sign
wsjHeadlines.description: The lender said Thursday that it wasn’t in any active discussions and it hadn’t received an approach for a potential takeover.

wsjHeadlines.title: Treasury Yields Rise Amid Hawkish Fedspeak
wsjHeadlines.description: Treasury yields ticked higher as Fed Governor Waller reiterated his call for a supersized interest rate increase in December.

wsjHeadlines.title: Alstom Shares Drop After Train Maker Floats Possible Equity Raise
wsjHeadlines.description: Shares fell more than 7% after the French train maker said it was considering equity funding and asset sales, among other options, to cut its debt load.

wsjHeadlines.title: Textron Selling Industrial Segment to Kingswood Capital for $1.2 Billion
wsjHeadlines.description: The signed a definitive sale agreement with an affiliate of Kingswood Capital Management that will see it bring in net cash proceeds of roughly $1.1 billion after tax and transaction-related expenses.

wsjHeadlines.title: Tech, Media & Telecom Roundup: Market Talk
wsjHeadlines.description: Find insight on Nvidia, JD.com, Hana Microelectronics and more in the latest Market Talks covering Technology, Media and Telecom.

wsjHeadlines.title: Financial Services Roundup: Market Talk
wsjHeadlines.description: Find insight on Suncorp, Medibank, Klarna and more in the latest Market Talks covering Financial Services.

wsjHeadlines.title: Nasdaq Futures Rise as Nvidia Earnings Calm AI Fears, Attention Turns to Anthropic
wsjHeadlines.description: Tech stocks rallied across the globe after Nvidia’s market-beating earnings steadied sentiment around the artificial-intelligence trade.

wsjHeadlines.title: Health Care Roundup: Market Talk
wsjHeadlines.description: Find insight on Convatec, Lupin, Roche and more in the latest Market Talks covering Health Care.

wsjHeadlines.title: European Chip Stocks Rise After Strong Nvidia Results
wsjHeadlines.description: Shares of European chip companies edged higher after Nvidia reported a strong set of results.

wsjHeadlines.title: Asian Equities Mixed as Investors Parse Nvidia’s Quarterly Results, Guidance
wsjHeadlines.description: Investors have been monitoring how Nvidia could perform without Jensen Huang, the only CEO the company had ever had until his resignation last week.

wsjHeadlines.title: U.S. Stocks Fall as AI Doubts Fester
wsjHeadlines.description: U.S. stocks finished lower as doubts about the sustainability of the artificial-intelligence boom festered ahead of Nvidia earnings and Anthropic’s market debut.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | Can Nvidia Thrive Without Jensen Huang?
wsjHeadlines.description: The company’s prospects depends on whether its board is able to avoid a series of common pitfalls.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | Rational Investing and Stock-Market Bubbles
wsjHeadlines.description: Readers debate investor behavior and how markets price risk.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | What’s Really Behind Data Center Backlash
wsjHeadlines.description: Midterm results aren’t a rejection of the technology itself but of the way developers handle projects.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | Congressional Insider Trading Isn’t as Common as You Think
wsjHeadlines.description: As with Mr. Pelosi’s Alphabet options, many insider-trading claims fall apart under scrutiny.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | ‘Peer-to-Peer’ Wagering Isn’t Gambling? Don’t Bet on It
wsjHeadlines.description: Kalshi says it is different from a sportsbook. Utah says Kalshi’s own trading arm acts like the house.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | Building Wealth Requires More Than Charity
wsjHeadlines.description: Handouts can’t scale to a whole nation. A market-based path to ownership can.

wsjHeadlines.title: U.S. Natural Gas Futures Gain on More Supportive Weather
wsjHeadlines.description: U.S. natural gas futures gained, adding to the previous day’s gains, as cooler weather forecasts improved the near-term demand outlook.

wsjHeadlines.title: Oil Prices Fall Amid Supply Surplus Expectations, Middle East Tensions
wsjHeadlines.description: Oil prices fell Wednesday as traders assessed the prospect of a global supply surplus amid renewed tensions in the Middle East and continued threats to regional oil shipments.

wsjHeadlines.title: Basic Materials Roundup: Market Talk
wsjHeadlines.description: Find insight on Endeavour Mining, BHP and more in the latest Market Talks covering Basic Materials.

wsjHeadlines.title: Gold Down 2.5% on Firmer Dollar, Rate-Hike Bets
wsjHeadlines.description: Gold prices dropped to their lowest levels in more than a year, pressured by a stronger dollar and expectations of further interest-rate hikes by the Fed this year.

wsjHeadlines.title: Oil Prices Pressured by Surplus Expectations, Bearish U.S. Inventory Data Report
wsjHeadlines.description: Oil prices fell as expectations of an oversupplied market and a bearish U.S. inventory data report outweigh continued tanker attacks in the Middle East.

wsjHeadlines.title: Dollar Could Fall in 2027 if Fed Cuts Rates
wsjHeadlines.description: The dollar could weaken next year, supporting the euro, as markets are overestimating the amount of tightening the Federal Reserve will deliver, ING said.

wsjHeadlines.title: WSJ Dollar Index Falls 0.04% to 98.42
wsjHeadlines.description: The WSJ Dollar Index edged lower, snapping a five-trading-day winning streak.
